text: Let go of all your concepts of God. Any of your ideas about God is merely a tiny idol limiting His boundlessness. To know the Truth, be ready to discard everything that you know about it. Absolutely everything! Including your ideas that God is good, harmonious, wise, strong, healthy... The more “attachments” you have—positive or negative—the more lessons you will receive in order to free yourself from them. Therefore take a step into the mystical darkness, where the mind falls silent, and the soul meets the mystery directly, without intermediaries in the form of your expectations.
